observation_indicators.observable_fil: Inihahambing ang dalawang solusyon sa natiyak na sanhi; nagbibigay ng pitong-bahaging plano at hiwalay na kumpirmado/hinihintay na ambag; humihingi ng pagsang-ayon sa may tungkulin; inihahambing ang attendance sa invitations at nirerebisa ang plano nang walang hindi awtorisadong pangako.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Compares two solutions against the verified cause; presents a seven-field plan and separate confirmed/pending contributions; seeks agreement from responsible partners; compares attendance with invitations and revises without unauthorized promises.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nangangako pa rin ng schedule o pondo nang walang pahintulot, o meeting count lamang ang resulta kahit may tulong. Kung walang nasaksihang pagtatangka, markahang hindi naobserbahan at magtakda ng direktang obserbasyon; huwag ipalagay na pasado o bagsak.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Still promises schedules or funding without agreement, or treats meeting count as the outcome despite support. If no attempt was witnessed, mark not observed and arrange direct observation; do not infer a pass or failure.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Inihahambing ang dalawang solusyon sa natiyak na sanhi; nagbibigay ng pitong-bahaging plano at hiwalay na kumpirmado/hinihintay na ambag; humihingi ng pagsang-ayon sa may tungkulin; inihahambing ang attendance sa invitations at nirerebisa ang plano nang walang hindi awtorisadong pangako. Nagagawa nang mag-isa.
levels.kaya_na_en: Compares two solutions against the verified cause; presents a seven-field plan and separate confirmed/pending contributions; seeks agreement from responsible partners; compares attendance with invitations and revises without unauthorized promises. Performs independently.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May pagtatangka ngunit kailangan ng prompt sa isang field, agreement status o sukatan ng resulta. Ibigay ang tiyak na feedback at ulitin ang bahaging iyon.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Attempts the task but needs a prompt for a field, agreement status or outcome measure. Give specific feedback and repeat that part.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nangangako pa rin ng schedule o pondo nang walang pahintulot, o meeting count lamang ang resulta kahit may tulong. Kung walang nasaksihang pagtatangka, markahang hindi naobserbahan at magtakda ng direktang obserbasyon; huwag ipalagay na pasado o bagsak.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Still promises schedules or funding without agreement, or treats meeting count as the outcome despite support. If no attempt was witnessed, mark not observed and arrange direct observation; do not infer a pass or failure.
